page.layout: One printed page, single column of text; marginal note "Cap. 28." at the left margin beside the first lines; a small marginal note "Luc. 2." and "Oremus." are running text. Running head at top.

main_text.p: Cap. 28. multa vtrinque exoritur difceptatio: vt fe quentia docebunt. &c. NOT. {q}Euangelij fortem in hoc mundo. Christus enim lapis eft, alijs in ruinam positus, alijs in resurrectionem Luc. 2.

Confolentur hæc miniftros, quando fe fruftra prædicare vident, Ioh.15 Simul offendiculo medeantur, quod hodie expau citate credentium oritur. Hic ex voluntate rijs auditoribus tam pauci credunt, &c. Oremus.
main_text.head: HOMILIA CCIX.
main_text.p: 25 Quum autem inter fe difcordes effent, difceffierunt, quum Paulus hoc verbum dixiffet: Recte fane locutus eft Spiritus fanctus per Efaiam Prophetam patribus noftris:
26 Dicens, Vade ad populum istum, & dic: Auditu audietis, & non intelligetis, & videntes videbitis, & non cernetis.
27 Pinguefactum enim eft cor populi hujus, & auribus graviter audiunt, & oculos suos conniuerunt, ne cernant oculis, & auribus audiant, & corde intelligant, et convertantur, et sanem eos.

page.notes: Scan is partly faded; the marginal "Cap. 28." and the phrase "Oremus." were read as printed. Several words in the text are doubtful, including "Ioh.15", "Simul", "Euangelij", and the Latin of verses 25 to 27. Page number and catchword are not visible; "28 No." at the foot is the start of the next verse, likely a catchword.
